routing.pattern: Each slide is an object { src, alt, caption }. Null entries render as placeholder cards. The carousel auto-derives its length, swipe bounds, and rendering from this array — no other code changes needed.
routing.addSlide: Push { src, alt, caption } to GALLERY_IMAGES. Remove a null placeholder if you want to keep the total count stable.
routing.removeSlide: Set the array entry to null (renders placeholder) or splice it out (shrinks carousel).
routing.reorder: Move entries within GALLERY_IMAGES — array order = carousel order.
routing.imageSpec: 16:9 aspect-ratio recommended (e.g. 1280x720, 1920x1080). object-fit: cover is applied.
